record_title: Sharp range-free empirical Cantelli bounds for exchangeable prediction
provenance: An exact finite-sample one-sided empirical Cantelli theorem for the externally studentized prediction residual under finite exchangeability, with a sharp p-box and explicit extremizers.
limitations: Sharpness is over exchangeable laws rather than the iid subclass; the result is unconditional rather than a p-box conditional on realized sample summaries; some exact extremizers use zero leave-one-out variance under an explicit extended convention; older distribution-free prediction literature may contain equivalent formulations.
